query: with recursive closure(namespace, name, depth) as ( select $1::text, $2::text, 0 union select b.namespace, b.name, closure.depth + 1 from closure join lineage.event_dataset a on a.namespace = closure.namespace and a.name = closure.name and a.direction = $3 join lineage.event_dataset b on b.event_id = a.event_id and b.direction = $4 where closure.depth < $5) select distinct namespace as "namespace!", name as "name!" from closure where not (namespace = $1 and name = $2) and ($6::text is null or (namespace, name) > ($6, $7)) order by namespace, name limit $8
